batting.name: SR Watson
batting.dismissal: c MEK Hussey b DJ Bravo

batting.name: R Dravid
batting.dismissal: c MS Dhoni b DJ Bravo

batting.name: MS Dhoni
batting.dismissal: c STR Binny b JP Faulkner

balls.text: fuller length delivery on the stumps, the batsman thumps it hard down the ground but is not able to beat the fielder at long on

another good yorker on the stumps, the batsman jams it out down the pitch and calls for a run. Bravo gets to the ball before the non-striker and he kicks it towards the stumps, but he hits it hard and beats Dhoni (who wanted to be a goalkeeper in his alt life.)
another pacy full delivery on the pads, the batsman flicks it to deep square leg where Vijay was at it, but he overruns it and lets it go through to the boundary
full delivery on the stumps, no space to get under it, the batsman punches it to long on and comes back for a couple
full delivery wide outside off, the batsman clears his front foot, but can only push it as far as mid off
bowls a short of length slower delivery from round the wicket, the batsman tries to guide it fine on the off side but is beaten
bowls an angled delivery on a length, the batsman wanted to slog it to deep square leg, but the ball gets stuck between his thighs
fuller length delivery on the stumps from wide of the crease, the batsman whacks it past the non-striker to long on
length delivery wide outside off, the batsman had got his front leg out and he slices it over point
bowls a quick short delivery, the batsman wanted to pull it but it whizzes past the bat
short of length delivery on off stump, the batsman chops it straight to point, but they steal a single anyway
he bowls a full toss on the pads from wide of the crease, the batsman punches it to deep midwicket
cracking drive to a fuller delivery, but it goes straight to deep extra cover
he bowls a slower delivery down the leg side
that is one mighty hit by Binny! It was a slower ball outside off and he was waiting for it, just goes for a full blooded swing of the bat and it goes deep into the stands over cow corner
bowls a slower low full toss on the stumps, the batsman goes on the back foot and pushes it to cover for a single

he falls immediately after getting to his hundred! Caught at extra cover! He moves outside leg stump and tries to go inside out to this full delivery, but it hits the toe end of the bat and it's a simple catch for Huss Master
he gets it with a little nudge to deep square leg of the front foot! Here is the first 100 this IPL! How easily has he done it.
slower delivery on  a length wide outside off, the batsman taps it to cover for a single
flatter delivery wide outside off, the batsman flat bats it to deep extra cover
he plays a sensible push to wide long off for a single
flatter delivery which the batsman slog sweeps, straight to the man at deep midwicket
finally gets a yorker! The batsman pushes it back to the bowler
oh no! Another super filthy wide outside off... What's going on
follows it up with a low full toss that is smashed back to the sight screen
Jajeja has lost it! He bowls a filthy filthy wide outside off
he bowls a full toss and Watson hits a home run to wide long on
oh what a delivery! He bowls a quick yorker which the batsman just about blocks out
back round the wicket and he bowls this full delivery way down the leg side... But it's a no-ball as he has overstepped too
another slower delivery on off stump, the batsman drags it to wide long on with a mow of a shot
bowls  a low full toss on the pads, punched down to long on
bowls length which Watson wanted to slam down the ground, but it was a slower one and the batsman gets an inside edge fine on the leg side
slower delivery wide outside off, Binny fails to get it away, finds the fielder at cover
short of length delivery wide outside off, the batsman cuts it straight to cover point
the batsman whips it to deep midwicket for an easy single
he moves a touch outside leg to make room and slaps it over extra cover with an inside out shot! Mohit gets one hand to it at the boundary, that was a good effort, but in vain
flatter delivery just outside off, the batsman wanted to cut it, but gets a bottom edge that goes past the keeper, to short fine leg
he comes forward to a quicker delivery and ends up getting a thick outside edge past short third man
bowls a flatter delivery wide outside off, the batsman flogs it in the air to deep point
full delivery on the stumps, the batsman comes forward and drives it down to long-off
another slower delivery, but this one is slightly wider outside off, the batsman drives it past point for a single
another slower ball, slightly fuller outside off, the batsman comes forward, waits, and drives it over extra cover with a straight bat
he waits in the crease to a length delivery and chops it to deep backward point for a quick couple
the batsman is greeted by a short delivery. He ducks under it in time

oh no! Dravid has been completely foxed by this slower delivery! He was moving outside leg to make room, but Bravo bowls an excellent slower offcutter. Dravid stretches out and just ends up lobbing a ridiculously easy chance to Dhoni, who gobbles it up
bowls back of length delivery on the off stump, the batsman tucks it towards backward square leg for a single
length delivery angling in to the batsman, Dravid pushes it firmly to midwicket
length delivery on the stumps, the batsman goes for a heave, but the ball comes in a touch into him. He ends up pushing it to midwicket for a single
short delivery that is bowled a little slow, the batsman swivels and pulls it to fine leg for a couple
shortish delivery on the stumps, the batsman goes back and pulls it straight to midwicket
bowls that yorker wide outside off, the batsman stretches to reach it but can't make any contact
fuller delivery on off and Watson greets Morris with a golf drive over the sight screen
tossed up delivery on off, the batsman defends it off the front foot
he come forward to this flighted delivery and turns it to backward square leg for a single
flatter delivery outside off, the batsman goes back and punches it firmly to deep extra cover
pushed through on the pads, the shortish length allows the batsman to whip it to deep midwicket
tossed up delivery outside off, Dravid comes forward and drives it down to long off
he bowls a carrom-ball on off stump, the batsman goes on the back foot and pushes it to cover for a single
another short delivery, normal pace, Watson hammers it normally too with a screaming pull shot. How well has Hussey done to keep it in again!

short delivery with lack of pace, the batsman has to wait as he goes for his pull, he ends up dragging it towards short fine where Bravo dives like a manic goalkeeper, but just gets a finger to it. But that goes to the boundary
tries to clip this short of length delivery towards the leg side, but it hits the inside edge and on to the thigh pad, they take a single
he stays on the back foot and opens the face to steer the back of length delivery to third man
short of length delivery on off, the batsman dabs it towards cover point off the back foot and they set off for a quick single..
tries to test Dravid with a short one! But it sails over the head, called a wide
short of length delivery outside off, the batsman runs it down to third man
he flights it around off stump, Watson comes forward and whips it to deep midwicket
full delivery on the pads, Dravid comes forward and tucks it to square leg for a single
he bowls the carrom ball, but the length is short. Dravid goes back and punches it hard to deep extra cover for a couple

oye no! the man of mystery has two wickets! It was that round-armish tossed up  delivery from round the wicket and Yagnik went for a slog sweep. He is nowhere near the pitch of the ball and ends up top-edging it. Easy catch for the bowler
tossed up delivery on the stumps, the batsman pushes it softly towards mid-on for a single
pushed through on the leg stump, the batsman gets hit on the pads and it rolls to short fine
short of length delivery angling in to the batsman, Watson whips it to deep backward square leg for an easy couple
bowls a slower delivery on off stump, the batsman dabs it to point. Yagnik took a few steps down, but was sent back in time
loses his line, bowls it down the leg side
bowls length delivery wide outside off to which Yagnik throws his bat, gets a thick outside edge down to third man
oh this one was nice! It was shortish delivery angling across the left-hander, but he arches back and upper cuts it over backward point, one bounce and four
another one round about the leg stump line, the batsman tries to push it to the leg side, but ends pushing it back to the bowler
bowls short of length on the pads, the batsman tries to flick it but gets hit on the thigh pad
lots of air in this one, and it's full too, driven to mid-on
bowls it slightly round-arm from round the stumps, the batsman clips it to deep midwicket off the front foot
fuller delivery on the stumps, the batsman comes forward and flicks it firmly to deep square leg
pushed through delivery on the stumps, the batsman drives it to long on

oh where did that come from! It's a proper offspinner's delivery - Tossed up outside off, slow as well, it turns big and bounces as well. Rahane tries to open the face to play it towards point, but it comes in a lot more than what he thought. It hits the top of the bat and crashes on to the stumps
tossed up delivery on off stump, the batsman comes forward and defends to off
this is what he was trying off the last ball. More shortish filth but this one has been murdered. Absolutely murdered. It ends up in the third tier at deep square leg. Fifty for Watson..
the length was only just short! But Watson went deep in the crease to pull it in the gap at deep midwicket! But Hussey comes running in and keeps the ball in..
tosses it up a touch, but it is on a leg stump line. Rahane taps it towards midwicket for another single
length delivery on the pads, the batsman comes forward and pushes it to deep midwicket with ease
pushes it through from round the wicket, but Watson goes down on his knee this time and paddles it fine for a boundary
he bowls it flat on the pads, the batsman goes back and glances it fine on the leg side for a couple
he comes forward to push it back to the bowler, but ends up chipping it just over the umpire as the ball stops on him a touch
wow! Aswhin thought that it was a good time to flight it up, and Watson loves it. He just hammers it along the ground past the umpire at non-striker's hand. No stopping that
he pushes it in the gap between midwicket and square leg and calls for a quick single
third time to Raina at square leg as the batsman flicks it off the front foot. It was just a little to the left of him and that was good enough for them to take a single
he comes forward and turns a flat delivery toward square leg again
bowls some short filth that Watson pulls hard, but he hits it straight to Raina at square leg
he keeps bowling on the pads and that's too easy for these batsmen, Rahane clips it to fine leg for a single
another one on the leg side, this one is too far down
now he takes a suicidal single after pushing it to the right of Raina! He was gone had Raina hit
this time he gets all of it! It is short delivery on the leg stump line and the batsman just swivels and powers it over deep backward square leg

almost a great catch by Mohit Sharma! He had to run a long way back from mid-off, but he was always chasing that delivery. Watson had lifted a length delivery towards the sight screen, but he didn't time it well
length delivery on off stump, the batsman comes forward and drives it straight with a very high elbow, to mid-on
oh no, he bowls short of length on the pads and Watson just guides it fine to the boundary on the leg side
another back of length delivery on the stumps, pushed to midwicket for a single
more short of length stuff by Holder. Watson has to rise with the ball, but the slowness makes him wait. He defends to off
back of length delivery angled in to the batsman, Rahane goes back and dabs it to midwicket for a quick single
it's in Rahane's half and he obliges by coming forward and playing a delectable on drive through midwicket
shortish delivery on the stumps, comes very slow off the surface. Watson dabs it towards square leg off the back foot for a single
short of length delivery on off, 138 kph, Rahane stays on the back foot and runs it down to third man
short of length delivery outside off, Watson is on the front foot and tries to whack it over cover, but it has bounced extra and it takes a thick edge to the third-man boundary
the slowness in the pitch is messing with their timing! Rahane comes forward to play an on the up drive through off, but gets an inside edge to backward square leg
bowls a clever slow delivery, very short it was. Rahane shapes to play the pull, but has to wait as the ball comes in really slow, steers it to fine leg
he bowls a short of length delivery wide outside off, Rahane goes on the back foot to play a punch, but the ball comes slow off the surface and he ends up hitting it back to the bowler
short delivery around off stump, Watson pulls, but doesn't get much behind it. It's a single to deep midwicket
he comes forward and lifts the length ball over the bowler's head.. Easily done. It just goes over the rope
goes for a full delivery and Rahane just clips it off his toes to deep backward square leg
angled delivery from wide of the crease, Rahane comes forward and defends
length delivery on off stump, angling in, the batsman pushes it to the left of midwicket for a single
gets good bounce from short of length, Rahane has to hop on his toes and he plays it down to fine leg
back of length delivery from wide of crease, Watson goes back and taps it to fine leg
bowls a 129 kph length delivery on off stump, Watson comes forward and drives to mid-off

plays it almost back to the bowler! It was a short of length delivery on off, Rahane goes on the back foot, but the ball comes a touch slow off the surface, he ends up almost playing it back to the bowler
just after the slip has been taken off, Watson plays a delicate little late cut to a short of a length delivery, towards third-man
length delivery on off stump, it is just the invitation Watson needs to plant his front foot forward and drive it on the up, but he hits it straight to mid on
keeps it just short of length round about on off stump, Watson goes back and defends towards cover
back of length delivery outside off, the batsman waits on the back foot and pushes it to point
bowl length on the pads, Watto flicks it straight to the fielder at midwicket, who allows it to pass under him! It was Bravo there.. through his legs.
Bravo seals it with a ball to spare, clips this low full toss off the pad wide of deep midwicket and Chennai have chased 185 after Watson's hundred
full toss outside off turned to wide long on and they take the second quite comfortably
Bravo gets lots of bat under it this time, making room to leg and sends this full one soaring over sweeper cover
Watson gets this very low and full, Bravo cannot get enough bat under it, hits it back to the bowler, non-striker was way out of his ground, but Watson was staring at the batsman
low full toss on middle, hit down to long on

Dhoni goes for the six, swipes over midwicket, but Binny has made ground to his right from long on, and jumped to take this over his head, they check replays for the no-ball, they zoom in and zoom out, Faulkner is fine
Cooper fumbles running across from deep midwicket as Dhoni swipes a full delivery, he's struggling on the second run
full into the pads, Bravo misses, they take the single as it rolls on the off side
in the blockhole wide outside off, Dhoni underedges it to the leg side
full outside off, tighter line, swiped powerfully through midwicket
full and wide, under the bat as Dhoni stretches for it
very full, rolls to the off side as Dhoni gets a thick inside edge onto pads, throw misses at the striker's end, direct hit and Bravo was gone
swats a full toss to Dravid at extra cover, who picks up the ball cleanly this time, then slaps it away, and concedes one more
Dhoni gets the boundary, full and widish, he powers it straight past the bowler, and long off's dive is in vain
full and wide, Dhoni cannot place it wide of extra cover, but Dravid lets it slip through, and kicks the air in frustration
pitched up, driven down to long off
angled full into the stumps, and wristily clipped through midwicket
full on the pads, flicked to deep square
stretches out to push a full one to point
full toss driven to long on
Faulkner, what a ball, accurate, quick yorker, on leg stump, and Jadeja cannot keep it out, seriously good delivery to get second ball
tries to steer to third man, edges to keeper on the bounce
uh oh, a direct hit and Hussey is way out of his ground, Dhoni sliced a low full toss to backward point, Hussey was keen on the single, but Dravid was right on target
another one, off a thick edge to the fine third man boundary
Hussey doing it every over, keeps finding the boundary, half a foot outside off stump, and he makes some room to create width and cuts it between short third and backward point
pitched up, the drive goes to extra cover
full and too wide, Hussey reaches out and steers it past short third man;s dive
full toss swiped down to long on
slow length ball on the pads, a furious pull but straight to deep square
length ball on middle and leg, Dhoni works behind square leg and rushes for the first, makes it back for the second
shortish, Hussey pulls to deep square leg, disappointed to find the fielder
wayward, skidding well down leg, keeper dives and parries it to short fine
and again, but this time, it is on the bounce to Cooper at deep midwicket
Hussey makes some room and swipes this short of a length delivery, one bounce over the deep midwicket rope
turned from off to deep square leg
outside off, cut wide of the sweeper
steered to short third man who keeps them to a single with a neat stop
picks up two more, a drive through extra cover, couple of seconds to catch his breath, and he's ready again
he's connecting with everything, slog-sweeps an offcutter from outside off now, and beats deep square leg by a long way
into the pads, and Hussey sweeps it well over short fine leg
angled too wide across the left-hander
nudged to short fine leg, Watson fumbles
Hussey hard to stop, works busily down to long on, who keeps them to one
pitched up, turned from outside off to long on
short down the leg side, Dhoni swivels to mistime the pull to fine leg

the ball has gone to the fine leg boundary, but Raina has to walk back, had no reason to do this, he's walked outside off, gone down for the scoop over short fine, missed the length ball, and been struck in front of off, hitting middle with the angle
Hussey slogs to long on now, all CSK at the moment
pitched up, Raina swipes this on  a couple of bounces to long on
fine drive, off a fullish delivery, down to long off
backs away and whips off the pads in front of square leg
into the pads on a length and Raina brings up fifty now, his first for the season
chopped in front of cover, Dravid is not quick enough to test them
cutting across on middle, he makes some room and pushes to long off
lifted on the  bounce to deep midwicket off the pad
pitched up around off, nudged to deep square
back of a length, turned through midwicket
yorker outside off, patted to the off side and that is another fifty for Hussey
another high full toss, widish, and sliced between backward point and short third man
slow, on the pads, Hussey in a tangle, misses, wants the single, has to rush back, bowler kicks it towards the stumps, Hussey was gone had he hit, but it was too wide
low full toss, outside off, eased to long off, poor stuff, RR
high full toss, outside off, Raina crashes it to the deep cover rope
good length, punched down to long off
nudged for two, superb running, turned from outside off to vacant midwicket, bowler after it, throw comes in, as does the Huss
was early across to off stump, and dragged a slower one to short fine
width, good length, and Hussey makes Trivedi pay, slices it high over backward point
drags this full one from way outside off to wide long on, and comes back for two
runs it off the front foot to short third, wild throw, but Hussey would have still made it had it been better
he's taken this from off on the walk, and turned it to short fine leg
charges out to a back of a length ball but can't time it through the off side
comes across to knock this length ball from outside off to long on
appeal for lbw, but that pitched outside leg, and rolled fine past the keeper on off
outstanding timing, wide length ball, Raina reaches out and goes through with the lofted drive, it flies over long off
middle and leg on a good length, turned in the air to deep square
Trivedi errs in line, and is immediately put away, length ball swinging in way down the pads, tickled past short fine
Hussey makes it through for the single, was a close one, he'd mistimed the drive to Dravid at extra cover, he was off balance as he threw, and missed, direct hit would have been very tight
opens the face to a length ball just outside off and runs it to third man
floated across, he pushes off the front foot, to extra cover
makes room outside leg, Trivedi follows him with a length ball, Raina squeezes it to long on
turned to deep midwicket
Raina waits on this length ball straightening outside off and punches straight to point
fuller and pushed through into the pads, worked down to long on
much quicker now, he cannot knock it to the leg side far enough for runs
pops it in the air to the off side, hit close to the splice as he comes forward
goes across and nudges a slow length ball angled in, to square leg
this should have gone, high full toss outside off, Raina pats it to extra cover, whose throw is wide and costs a run
another direct hit, from the bowler as he charges to off close to the pitch, but Hussey has made it after failing to connect with one on the pads
he errs in line again, and Hussey is putting away everything remotely loose, slow and wide, cut hard to the deep point rope
Cooper alright with the line again, just outside off, good length, turned with an open face in front of point, there is a direct hit, too late though
slowish length ball, tighter line, Raina gets a thick inside edge to bowler
first ball Cooper has been slammed over extra cover for six, wide length ball, Raina stretching for it with a lunge forward and a bend of the knee
full on middle and leg, Raina moving across big time, and gets bat around pad to work to deep square
full and into the batsman, Hussey picks up the single as mid on is a touch deepish
beaten with the away swing, there has hardly been any around in the chase, Hussey looking for the drive
works a pitched up delivery from outside off to deep square leg
pushes a length ball to the bowler
Raina with the slog over wide mid on, length ball angled in, right in his swinging zone
nice, Shukla slows it down once more, Hussey is on the charge down the wicket and has built up enough momentum to crash it past extra cover, slow ball or not
fails to connect with a shortish one angled in, hit on the thigh pad, and Hussey makes it through even as the bowler rushes up the pitch for the ball
pushes a length ball to point
short ball, bounces sharply on Raina, who swings, and top edges over the keeper
took the pace off it this time, but Hussey waited and managed to time the square drive, required a dive from backward point
Hussey likes the pace on offer from Shukla on the slow wicket and slogs a length ball between midwicket and mid on
full and pushed through on the pads, tucked to deep square
tossed up now, he pushes it past the bowler's dive for one
quickly comes in with the angle, Raina backs away and punches from off and middle to extra cover
tame dismissal for Vijay, he's skipped out too, and gone through with the lofted drive to a length ball he did not quite reach the pitch of, and hit a loopy shot back to the bowler
turned square on leg for one
Hussey doing the early damage, gets maximum early in the over, skips out, as Chandila pushes it in just short of a length, it bounces, but Hussey easily swipes it over deep midwicket
shortish outside off and another pull, in the air this time, but well short of the man at deep square leg
angled in full, Hussey cannot get enough bat on the drive, mistimes to mid on
a pull now, off the front foot, wasn;t that short, and did not bounce much, but Hussey in total control, hitting it behind forward square leg
this will go, Shukla pushes it widish on a length, and that is enough for Hussey to slice it hard over backward point
misfield, Rahane rushes in from point, but fails to pick up the ball, would have been a much tighter run other wise, after a back of a length ball was softly pushed towards the fielder
skiddy from just short of a length, he tries to cut, it is not that wide, and he chops it close to the pitch
pushed through into the pads, turned square for a single
that hurried on with the angle, from round the stumps, Hussey stabbed it to leg with a thick inside edge
angled in full once more, quicker, pushed down to long on
angled in full from wide of the crease, he comes out but is cramped for room
tossed up, he is forward to drive to long ff
length ball spinning tamely into the pads, worked square
